native_metrics.measurement_note: Native SQLite token counters are cumulative reported request usage, not unique tokens or a billing estimate. Turn spans include tool waits/backoff; they are not provider decode times.

provider_throughput.method: Three serial direct LiteLLM short-context streaming requests; 256 maximum output tokens, temperature 0, thinking disabled, usage requested. Decode approximation=(completion_tokens-1)/(last-first content timestamps). Generated content was not retained. These are provider samples, not native agent throughput. Later samples share the input prefix.

privacy_verification.scope: Exact current LiteLLM/OpenCode Go/operator secret values and current Forgejo admin tokens from ignored configuration; no claim of exhaustive detection of unknown historical credentials.
